messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 - inference-service high error-rate (service: /v1/generate). Incident ID: INC-2026-1184. Start: ~2026-02-24T18:02Z. Notifying #incidents and on-call.

oncall-eric: I got it, looking. seeing 5xx spike, routing errors -> 502s. putting mitigation on the board. will triage cause, ETA 15m.

sre-maddie: quick note — autoscaler flapped due to OOM on quantized model shards, observed at 18:01:42 UTC. we've rolled back to stable model variant and restarted affected pods. success rate recovered ~18:28Z.

oncall-eric: thanks @sre-maddie. can you paste the window we should use for customer impact and SLA calc? billing will need exact start/end + scope (hosted vs dedicated).

sre-maddie: for hosted API customers: error window 18:01:42 -> 18:28:03 UTC. token-level failures recorded in request logs (code 502 gateway). approx 427k tokens attempted, ~24% failures during window. affected routes: /v1/generate (all models behind inference-service).

oncall-eric: copying to thread so billing has context. @billing-sarah — can you confirm eligibility rules and whether this meets compensation thresholds?

billing-sarah: pinged. quick checklist: 1) Did the outage exceed SLA window threshold (>= 15 mins)? yes. 2) Were affected customers on Dedicated / Private? we only credit Hosted usage unless contract says otherwise. 3) We need per-customer downtime% or error-rate and usage in tokens or compute units during window. Please hand over CSV with columns we can ingest.

cs-lee: FYI a handful of enterprise customers reported degraded responses: AcmeCorp, Papertrail Labs, and NimbusAI — flagged via support. AcmeCorp had rate-limited retrying and saw API timeouts from 18:05-18:25. they asked for an ETA on credits.

ops-amy: putting together a short customer-facing note draft. idea: transparent, timing, what happened, mitigation steps, and next steps on credits. keep it short.

oncall-eric: dropping a first draft for review, will send to customers who opened tickets and the status page update. feedback pls.

ops-amy: 
```
Hello — we experienced elevated error rates for our text generation API between 18:01 UTC and 18:28 UTC on 2026-02-24. The issue was due to an infrastructure regression that caused OOMs on a model shard; we reverted to a stable variant and services recovered at 18:28 UTC.

Impact: some API requests returned 502/timeout responses. We are currently assessing affected usage and eligibility for service credits. If you saw errors during this window, your support ticket will be updated and our billing team will follow up about credits where applicable.

We apologize for the interruption. For questions, reply here or email support@redwood.example.com.
```

sre-maddie: minor wording tweak: change "reverted to a stable variant" -> "rolled back to a stable model variant and restarted affected workers". Also recommend including link to incident postmortem when available.

ops-amy: updated draft accordingly, thanks.

oncall-eric: billing handoff payload (CSV) — please take this format so billing can compute credits directly:

```
customer_id,customer_name,plan_type,affected_route,impact_start_utc,impact_end_utc,total_tokens_attempted,failed_token_count,notes
CUST-102,AcmeCorp,Hosted,/v1/generate,2026-02-24T18:01:42Z,2026-02-24T18:28:03Z,123456,31200,reported via support ticket #4567
CUST-210,Papertrail Labs,Hosted,/v1/generate,2026-02-24T18:03:10Z,2026-02-24T18:25:59Z,45000,10800,auto-detected
```

billing-sarah: perfect. two asks: (1) include region column if customers are cross-region, (2) include a pre-calculated downtime_percentage field if you can. otherwise we can compute.

oncall-eric: added region and downtime_percentage. new header below.

```
customer_id,customer_name,plan_type,region,affected_route,impact_start_utc,impact_end_utc,total_tokens_attempted,failed_token_count,downtime_percentage,notes
```

cs-lee: AcmeCorp wants a direct note. here's a slightly more formal customer-facing blurb we should send from CS. cc @billing-sarah for the credit note.

```
Hi Sam — we wanted to follow up about the service interruption on 2026-02-24. We saw elevated 502 errors between 18:01 and 18:28 UTC impacting your text generation requests. Our engineering team reverted a recent model shard change and restored service. We are preparing a credit for impacted usage and billing will reach out with details. Sorry for the disruption — we know this affects your workflows and appreciate your patience.
```

billing-sarah: good. last step for billing: once you drop the CSV in the billing queue, we'll run the SLA calc using plan rules: Hosted plans get token-level credit when error_rate >= 20% during window or total downtime >= 15 minutes. We'll respond with estimated credit amount and a draft invoice adjustment.

oncall-eric: dropping CSV to billing queue now: s3://redwood-incident-uploads/INC-2026-1184/credits_payload_1719408123.csv (public link restricted). @billing-sarah tagging you.

billing-sarah: got it, ingesting now. I'll update here when calculation is done (ETA ~2 business hours).

ops-amy: filing internal comms template for postmortem and status page text. tagging docs owner to add to the incident page: https://status.redwood.example/INC-2026-1184

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1184 severity reduced to SEV3 — monitoring.

oncall-eric: thanks all — handing over to billing + cs for credits and customer comms. I'll join if any follow-ups needed. :white_check_mark:

billing-sarah: will follow up with the formal credit amount and customer-facing language once we finish the calc. moving to billing queue.

cs-lee: I'll send the CS note to AcmeCorp and Papertrail once billing confirms amounts.

ops-amy: recorded this template in the internal incident-assets repo for future handoffs.

sre-maddie: adding final note: root cause is a model-shard allocation bug triggered by a recent quantization rollout. follow-up action: pin rollout and add extra OOM guardrails.

oncall-eric: thread closed for on-call; leaving it open for billing/CS.
